Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner set a faulty search strategy from the start by directing WebSurfer to use the incorrect domain “royals.se” (instead of the official “kungahuset.se”/Royal Court) and malformed place names without proper diacritics, leading to repeated no-result searches. This misdirection impeded obtaining an authoritative citation and caused looping, despite the correct answer (Princess Madeleine) being readily confirmable from the official Royal Court site.
